faqs.q: How long does a shingle roof replacement take?

pricing.summary: In Florida, a full roof replacement typically runs $9,000 to $22,000 for architectural shingle, $18,000 to $45,000 for metal, and $20,000 to $45,000 or more for clay or concrete tile. Flat roofing usually falls between $8,000 and $20,000. Inspections and estimates are free, and financing options run from 12 months up to 10 years.
